offering_description.value: Sells auto and property insurance to individuals and businesses, with personal auto as its largest line. Its insurance subsidiaries underwrite policies sold through independent agents and handle claims.

primary_products.value: personal auto insurance; homeowners insurance; commercial auto insurance; business owners insurance; personal umbrella insurance

customer_segment.value: B2C: Drivers, homeowners and renters; B2B: Small businesses and commercial vehicle operators

end_markets.value: personal auto insurance; residential property insurance; commercial auto insurance; small-business property and liability insurance

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: Policyholders pay premiums for auto, property and liability coverage

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Pools policyholder premiums and assumes auto, property and liability risks for individuals and businesses

geography_served.value: US regional: Massachusetts, New Hampshire and Maine

specialization.value: related lines: Personal and commercial auto, homeowners, business owners and umbrella coverage

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State insurance regulators license insurers and oversee solvency, rates and policy forms
